subject.title: Legacy google provider block fails current model-catalog schema (missing api, input audio/video, cost.cacheWrite) → provider silently unavailable + 120s idle timeout on fallback

question: Which open Google legacy-provider migration PR should be the canonical landing path, and should fallback idle-timeout behavior remain tracked separately before this issue closes?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and not fixed on main, but several open proof-backed PRs overlap and the report includes runtime fallback behavior beyond the migration-only fix.

options.title: Land one proof-backed migration and split fallback tracking
options.body: Choose the strongest Google doctor-contract migration PR, remove duplicate branches after merge, and keep a narrow follow-up for fallback idle-timeout behavior if it is not fixed there.

options.title: Broaden the canonical PR before merge
options.body: Ask the chosen PR to include both migration repair and fast-fail or skip behavior so this issue can close as fully implemented after merge.

options.title: Keep issue open after a migration-only merge
options.body: Merge the migration fix but leave this issue or a linked follow-up open until the fallback timeout symptom is resolved or explicitly ruled out.

recommendation.title: Land one proof-backed migration and split fallback tracking
recommendation.body: Choose the strongest Google doctor-contract migration PR, remove duplicate branches after merge, and keep a narrow follow-up for fallback idle-timeout behavior if it is not fixed there.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the clearest current-main routing candidate for the model-registry/config/doctor-contract surface based on blame and PR metadata.
